rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that happens or is true every time.

example.english: When the weather turns cold, I invariably can't resist having hot pot.
example.traditional: 天氣一凍，我總係忍唔住要食打邊爐。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 jat1 dung3 ngo5 zung2 hai6 jan2 m4 zyu6 jiu3 sik6 daa2 bin1 lou4

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the same thing happens on every occasion.

example.english: I invariably remember to bring my keys.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 ci3 dou1 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4

rows.note: Use this for a consistent pattern that has held over a period of time.

example.english: I have invariably avoided spicy food.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 m4 sik6 laat6
